# udoma_allocation_key (Resource)

Resource represents how a shared cost is distributed across properties or units.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the allocation key, for example `by area`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional explanation of the allocation key.
- `formula` (String) Pseudocode or mathematical expression defining how costs are distributed.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) The date and time the allocation key was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the allocation key.
- `is_catalog_item` (Boolean) Whether this entity is represented as a catalog item.
- `updated_at` (Number) The date and time the allocation key was last modified.
